description: This file defines a static class ConfigureWebServices that adds web-related services to an ASP.NET Core dependency injection container, including MediatR and various service interfaces for the eShopOnWeb project.

classes.name: ConfigureWebServices
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure web services in the application.
